Answer: C
Reason: The CT images (Figures 4a and 4b) clearly show hyperdense, radiopaque material within the pulmonary arteries consistent with acrylic cement emboli. This iatrogenic obstruction causes redistribution of blood flow to non-occluded vessels, explaining the pronounced vessels in the upper and ventral lung areas seen on the chest X-ray.
